Item 5 (default version): verified in code (v1 default everywhere), and snapshot_build/diff_pre_post.json records noop:true with identical thresholds and predicted sets 95/73/146 — the mechanical basis for 'the join is downstream of the scorer'. NON-BLOCKING OBSERVATIONS for the record: (a) evaluate() given caller-supplied joins together with join_version=2 does not populate join_facts (facts are computed only when evaluate builds the joins itself), so a refused passage on that future path would land in a legacy zero-match stratum rather than the refusal stratum; the accounting identity still holds and no current caller exercises the path — flag for the S8 census implementation; (b) v2 also carries the mixed-variant (segmentation option 1) lever shared with the parallel P2 cycle; this cycle's predictions are pinned on mixed_variants=False so the levers stay separated, consistent with the manifest.
